title: Virginia Beach Boardwalk History Tour
includes: Historic tour of the Virginia Beach boardwalk
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the boardwalk of Virginia Beach and its history on this tour of the city's historic coastal community. Learn about the growth of the city as a tourist hotspot, the growth of the hotel industry, and the rise of its distinct early 20th-century boardwalk culture. Hosted by a professional historian, this tour will give you unique insight into the city's history. Whether you are a local, visitor, or new arrival, this tour will help you explore the fascinating culture and history of VA Beach
